cs.t: I disagree on his recommendations. I was looking around for a good entry level DSLR (narrowed it down to Canon & Nikon). For the "Best Serious Camera" he recommended the Nikon D5000. I couldn't be happier with this camera. It's easy to use and takes fantastic pictures:  http://www.kenrockwell.com/tech/recommended-cameras.htm
